verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing claims accounting sync with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite plus 'AI-powered automations to close your books faster' [mercury-docs-6]. That is a first-party, close-acceleration AI capability tied to the GL systems, but it never explicitly says AI assigns GL codes or categories to transactions. The Categories API and agent-driven 'categorizing transactions' are developer building blocks, not built-in AI auto-coding, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI auto-assigns GL codes/categories, any multi-entity or cross-entity support, detail on how the sync maps codes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
